text: Wind's howling through the rigging and Gerrit has given up on the aerial. Greta Van Fleet, The Cold Wind. Right on cue.
First coffee in the mug, Opa coughing into life. Fleetwood Mac, Monday Morning. On a boat, every morning is a bit of a Monday.
Bright out there, the water's throwing it back into the wheelhouse. Cream, Sunshine Of Your Love. I didn't plan it. I'll take the credit.
The Opposites, Slapeloze Nachten. Sleepless nights. It's dark, the lighthouse is going round, and I'm awake. So are you. Here's to us.
The light's back on the water and the first warm days are coming. Moke, Here Comes the Summer. Gerrit's already looking at the deck for somewhere to lie.
Here Comes the Summer, sing Moke. It's already here, mate. Deck's warm enough to fry a fish on, and Gerrit's checking.
Sun going down behind the lighthouse, sky going orange. Jack Johnson, Sunsets For Somebody Else. Not this one. This one's mine.
Real lightning out there, so I've unplugged everything I can and kept the one thing I can't. Arctic Monkeys, Crying Lightning. If we go quiet, you know why.
Throw those curtains wide, Elbow say, and for once the day deserves it. Clear sky, flat sea. One Day Like This.
Late now. Opa's ticking over, the lighthouse sweeping round. Jack Johnson, Sleep Through The Static. Go on. I'll keep watch.
Fog so thick I can't see the bow, and the whole world's gone quiet out there. Depeche Mode, Enjoy the Silence. Easy enough, in this.
Snow on the deck, snow on the wheelhouse roof, snow on Gerrit. Cream, White Room. He is not amused.
